sloka: तेषाम् बाणैः महाबाहुः शस्त्राणि आवार्य वीर्यवान् ।जहार समरे प्राणान् चिच्छेद च शिरो धरान् ॥३-२५-२८॥
transliteration: teṣām bāṇaiḥ mahābāhuḥ śastrāṇi āvārya vīryavān ।jahāra samare prāṇān ciccheda ca śiro dharān ॥3-25-28॥

translations.english: The heads, armour and bows fell down broken on the ground like trees in the wind gererated by Garuda's wings.
